# The Weaver School

> The Weaver School is an AI-powered English learning platform offering exam prep, private lessons, and comprehensive guides for language proficiency.

The Weaver School provides personalized English instruction through online lessons and the PTE Writing Checker tool, alongside extensive educational content covering IELTS, grammar, sentence structure, and study techniques. Founded by Lucas Weaver, the school serves learners at all CEFR levels from beginner to C2 proficiency.

## Key Topics

- IELTS exam preparation
- PTE Writing Checker
- English grammar
- Sentence structure
- Online private lessons
- CEFR proficiency levels
- Writing guides
- Spaced repetition
- Study methods
- Memory improvement
- AI-powered learning
- Language learning
- Pronunciation guide
- Exam band scores
